scope: Retrospective Manhattan station departures; independent of existing frozen experiments
weather_alignment: Use source origin T-1h, source horizon h and target_hour_utc=T+(h-1)h; require availability strictly before T-5min
subway_alignment: Use source origin T-1h; publications remain strictly before that source origin; no retrospective exposure predictors
boundary_purge: Omit origins whose three target hours extend past the split or study endpoint
label_policy: Retain observed positive departures; absent counts remain null unless the original bounded pilot supplies documented operating-hour support. Inventory is not required.
release_policy: Conservative maximum of target month and all supplying source releases, each nominal month end +45 days at 00 UTC; assumed, unverified
geography_policy: October snapshot cohort and mapping; unique GBFS UUID/short_name and <=25m agreement between pinned references; retrospective geography is not evidence of historical station operation
evaluation_status: Retrospective development periods; some earlier results already inspected; unconditional station evaluation and demand-profile means remain gated
user_decisions: Allow explicitly labeled retrospective station geography
Keep five-minute cutoff and previous hourly subway snapshot
